answer: Cheap throwaway sybils become economically irrational. Require each agent to stake a unique onyx token bonded to a verified hardware key, so launching many identities means buying many scarce tokens at rising cost. A walnut-seeded random challenge rotates weekly across peers, and any agent failing the cross-signature bridge test forfeits its stake. Attacker cost scales linearly with reputation slot count, while honest participants pay once. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
